actions.title: Empty transaction
actions.plainEnglish: This transaction has no value or calldata.

findings.title: Empty transaction
findings.plainEnglish: This transaction sends no value and carries no calldata. It may be a nonce probe or administrative placeholder.

summaryBullets: This transaction has no value or calldata.
recommendation: Looks like a normal transfer. Verify recipient and amount out-of-band before signing.
limitationNote: This tool decodes and analyzes transaction data locally. It cannot prove what another UI showed to a signer and cannot verify signer device security. Always verify recipient, amount, and intent through an independent channel.
